summary.en: Refine results, run commands on the selected text, see recent questions, set things per app, use Apple Intelligence on your Mac, and hide sensitive information before sending. The first release notarized by Apple.
summary.zh: 可以修改结果、对选中的文字用命令、查看最近的问题、按 App 设置，支持本机的 Apple Intelligence，发送前可以隐藏敏感信息。首个经过 Apple 公证的版本。
